description: Call first. Resolves a Google Maps link or place_id and reports whether a trust result is cached, how fresh it is, and a recommendation: use the cached result, or collect and submit the reviews (also when a cached single-source result would benefit from your corroboration). Never contacts Google.

place_id.description: Google's feature id for the place (0x…:0x…, the '!1s' segment of a /maps/place URL).

url.description: Alternative to place_id: a Google Maps place link (long /maps/place/… URL or ?cid= link). Share short-links cannot be resolved; open them first.

name: check_place
title: Is this place already analyzed?
